scenarios.name: green-mana-unavailable-without-mountain-or-forest
scenarios.why: The green-producing ability requires control of a Mountain or Forest; the Verge alone has neither subtype.

scenarios.name: green-mana-offered-with-mountain
scenarios.why: Controlling a Mountain satisfies the stated land-type condition, making the green-producing ability available.

scenarios.name: green-mana-activates-with-forest
scenarios.why: A Forest meets the subtype condition. Activating the available mana ability taps the Verge and adds green mana.
